summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K extending the expiration date of its subscription rights offering from June 29 to July 15, 2026. The offering gives holders one right per share to buy one common share at $6.90, with an over-subscription privilege for fully exercising basic rights. No fractional shares. Terms remain unchanged. This is a rights offering to raise capital from existing shareholders, effectively a capital return mechanism. Watch for take-up rate and over-subscription demand to gauge capital raise success; no premium or deal mechanics beyond per-share price and expiration.
